blocks.text: Answer customer calls and emails about orders, deliveries and returns.
Process refunds and exchanges following company policy.
Update customer records after every interaction.
Escalate unresolved complaints to a team lead.
Track open cases until they are closed.
Explain product features and warranty terms to customers.
Place replacement orders for damaged items.
Keep the returns log accurate at the end of each shift.
Help train new representatives on the phone system.
Follow up with customers after a problem is resolved.
Flag recurring product issues to the operations team.
Cover the front counter during busy periods.
One year of customer service experience in retail or a call centre.
Comfortable handling cash and card payments.
Working knowledge of business systems such as order management software.
Able to work evenings and weekends.
